easyPrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce mana.
Incubation Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, targeting Incubation Druid.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Staff of Domination's ability, targeting Incubation Druid.
Resolve the first Staff of Domination ability, untapping Incubation Druid.
Holding priority, activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of a color a land you control can produce
Resolve the second Staff of Domination ability, untapping Incubation Druid.
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of a color a land you control can produce
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
